description: With no filters: every route and screen with its count, error rate, p50, p95 and slowest dependency. With any filter: matching spans from the backend and the app, or count, avg, p50, p95 and errors with group_by. Use it to find what is slow or failing, then open one with get_trace. Spans are kept 30 days.

environment.description: Only this environment, like production ('all' for every one)

group_by.description: Counts and timings per value instead of spans. release and environment also give p75, p90, p99 and time spent

op.description: Like http.server, http.client, ui.load, app.start, gen_ai, mcp.server

q.description: Text in the span name, any case

status.description: ok, error, or one HTTP status like 503

timeseries.description: true: points over time instead of rows (per minute, error rate, p50, p95), with where releases started

to.description: An ISO time, or how long ago

name: search_traces
title: Search spans and slow routes
